{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in flipper_length_mm
print("Missing values in flipper_length_mm:")
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum())

# Check mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print("\nMean flipper length by species:")
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Find species with highest mean flipper length
max_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
max_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {max_species}")
print(f"Mean flipper length: {max_value}")"}
